visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit kitchen studio. A woman wearing a cream t-shirt and a purple apron is seen from a medium-full shot, using a sharp knife to slice green onions into thin rounds on a large yellow cutting board. The background is a clean, modern kitchen with white cabinets and a large window. (2) The shot changes to a close-up of the yellow cutting board as the woman's hands skillfully dice a half-onion, first with horizontal cuts and then rotating to chop into fine cubes. A red pot and induction stove are visible in the blurred background. (3) The camera captures the diagonal slicing of red chili peppers followed by two red tomatoes being cut into chunky wedges. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the fresh textures of the vegetables. (4) The woman uses a knife to cut a green zucchini in half lengthwise and then into chunky pieces. Her movements are deliberate and rhythmic. A white ceramic plate with grated garlic appears in a separate step as she rubs a clove against a grater. (5) Transition to the cooking phase on a black induction cooktop. The woman pours olive oil from a blue bottle into a black pan, followed by adding the sliced green onions, which sizzle as they are stirred with a black spatula. (6) Minced pork is added to the pan. The woman uses the spatula to spread the meat evenly and sprinkles seasoning from a red shaker. The steam rises from the pan, indicating heat. (7) The diced onions, chili slices, and garlic are added to the meat mixture. She stir-frys the ingredients together until the onions become translucent. (8) Korean chili paste and powder are added. The woman briefly turns off the heat to stir-fry the spices into the meat, turning the entire mixture a vibrant red color. (9) Soy sauce is deglazed into the pan, followed by tomato chunks. She adds a brown broth from a clear pitcher and then large scoops of soft white tofu. Zucchini and more chilies are added as the soup begins to boil. (10) In the final phase, she drops a whole raw egg into the boiling stew and adds fresh clams. The scene shifts to her sitting at a dining table, serving the red stew into a heart-shaped pink bowl next to a bowl of rice topped with the semi-cooked egg. She smiles, eats a large spoonful, and reacts to the heat with a slightly surprised but happy expression.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 一株蒜苗，切成圓片. (2) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥半顆，先切幾刀. (3) [Subtitle]: 轉個方向，再切成細丁. (4) [Subtitle]: 辣椒一到兩條 斜切成片... (5) [Subtitle]: 番茄兩顆 切成塊狀... (6) [Subtitle]: 其實純豆腐鍋不會加番茄 但是我覺得一點番茄 可以增加湯底的層次 會有自然的甜味. (7) [Subtitle]: 通常韓國人也會放櫛瓜 也能增加膳食纖維攝取喔！ (8) [Subtitle]: 切成塊狀即可. (9) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭磨成蒜泥. (10) [Subtitle]: 所有的材料表 請看留言板喔！ (11) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱 放入適量橄欖油.. (12) [Subtitle]: 放入蒜苗進來爆香 充分炒出香味... (13) [Subtitle]: 接著再把絞肉放進來炒. (14) [Subtitle]: 盡量攤平.. 撒點胡椒調味. (15) [Subtitle]: 將絞肉炒到表面轉白. (16) [Subtitle]: 並且煸出豬油. (17) [Subtitle]: 接著放入洋蔥末、辣椒、蒜末. (18) [Subtitle]: 充分的拌炒出香氣. (19) [Subtitle]: 把洋蔥炒到半透明的狀態. (20) [Subtitle]: 先暫時關火一下 放入韓式辣椒醬 韓式辣椒粉... (21) [Subtitle]: 關火來炒， 辣椒粉比較不會炒糊. (22) [Subtitle]: 直到所有的食材都被染紅為止 這時候就可以開中火了. (23) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡嗆入醬油... 激發出醬香. (24) [Subtitle]: 接著放入番茄塊 將番茄炒軟... (25) [Subtitle]: 火不要太大， 讓番茄稍微煮軟一下... (26) [Subtitle]: 先取出一半的份量 這樣下次要煮就很快了！ (27) [Subtitle]: 接著加入約800~1000ml 昆布柴魚高湯 (2人份). (28) [Subtitle]: 放入韓式嫩豆腐.. (29) [Subtitle]: 中小火煮滾. (30) [Subtitle]: 中途加入櫛瓜. (31) [Subtitle]: 辣椒. (32) [Subtitle]: 豆腐大約煮幾分鐘左右 就差不多囉... (33) [Subtitle]: 最後放入適量的蛤蠣提鮮. (34) [Subtitle]: 煮到蛤蠣開口即可. (35) [Variety]: 喜歡蛋的朋友 ❤️. [Subtitle]: 哎呀～蛋滑進去了～哈. (36) [Subtitle]: 像這樣煮半熟最好吃！ (37) [Subtitle]: 好囉～那我要開動囉 ❤️. (38) [Subtitle]: 淋一點湯汁 ❤️. (39) [Subtitle]: 搓破蛋黃...攪拌攪拌 ❤️. (40) [Subtitle]: 沾滿蛋汁的飯.. ❤️. (41) [Subtitle]: 吃一口嫩豆腐. (42) [Subtitle]: 豆腐好燙～哈 ❤️. (43) [Logo]: 臉書：羅潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@Rosalin. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG.
